policy: Independent source reviews annotate unresolved catalogue entries. They do not add geometry or override generated classifications. Reviews must be checked again when an entry identity or source classification changes.

records.nextStep: Identify the historical northern open course between its separate timing endpoints, including the northern notch and inner hairpin; the connected 2,279.7 m current public-road candidate omits those features. Do not substitute a full southern combined loop.

Find reusable fine historical imagery or a licensed course survey. The June 2019 native 10 m image does not resolve the old compact course, and the inspected nearby public GPS samples follow a civilian road rather than the circuit.

Independently recover the 2021 inner extension and tight switchbacks. Regional road vectors omit course roads, and the local geotopographic survey dates to 2008. Clear November 2021 native 10 m imagery locates the new pavement but does not resolve every tight connector.

Recover the event southern turnaround and temporary chicanes from a licensed event-date survey or GPS recording. Fine public May 2023 imagery resolves the permanent median opening but cannot establish the race turnaround farther south; the civilian road loop remains excluded.

Recover the small western closing connector independently; the available full-course way includes the separate Thunder branch. Nearby public GPS samples remain on civilian roads. Fine NLSC public display imagery has not established permission for derivative course coordinates.

Identify the historical main-course branch order in the public 2019 one-metre intensity grid and 2017 practice footage. The central parallel sections and alternatives must not be joined into an unsupported single lap; the later rebuild is not a substitute.

Identify the historical frontstretch short road-course branch order. Independently georeferenced 2014 one-metre and 2022 0.6-metre NAIP images show the pavement, but the quarter-mile oval and later simulator short course do not establish the requested layout.
